'''December 2000 San Jose tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in San Jose, California on 9 December 2000. [[Kevin Shannon]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1525">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-10-san-jose-ca-12-9-00d1525/ san-jose-ca-12-9-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 10 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-10-san-jose-ca-12-9-00d1525/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 December 2000
* '''Site:''' San Jose, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]
